long_biography.plain_text:
For hospitality entrepreneur David Grutman, the failure of Cameo nightclub was an expensive lesson in choosing priorities. He had taken an ownership opportunity after an employer declined to make him a partner. He later acknowledged that concentrating on beating his former colleagues had distracted him from running the business.

At Florida International University, Grutman brought students into working restaurants and a nightclub as part of his hospitality course. His guests included hotel executives who explained daily operations and restoration work. Classroom topics ranged from leasing versus ownership to purchasing and landscaping. Students could examine the practical decisions behind a venue alongside the customer experience.
